name: status_bar_scene_change
description: Hit the training Dummy in Town so its floating health bar appears, then walk to Field and back. No HealthLocalStatus bar may be left without an owner after a scene change.

steps.note: 10 is the Dummy that stands in Town; the player walks to it

steps.name: the hit shows the Dummy's floating health bar
steps.note: bars counts health bars of characters other than the player; if this fails the test cannot show the bug

steps.name: in Field: no health bar without an owner
back in Town: no health bar without an owner
